info.name: KubeVirt List VirtualMachines in a namespace

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: Label selector to filter resources.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: Field selector to filter resources.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results per page.

params.name: continue
params.description: Pagination continuation token.

items.docs: Returns all VirtualMachine resources in the specified namespace. Each VirtualMachine defines a desired VM configuration and controls whether the VM is running or stopped.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

items.docs: Creates a new VirtualMachine resource defining the VM's CPU, memory, disk, network configuration, and run strategy. KubeVirt will create a VirtualMachineInstance when the VM is started.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Returns the specified VirtualMachine resource including its current status, run strategy, and associated VirtualMachineInstance reference.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Replaces the entire VirtualMachine resource. Changes to the template take effect on the next VM start or restart.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Applies a partial update to the VirtualMachine using JSON Merge Patch or Strategic Merge Patch.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Deletes the VirtualMachine resource. If the VM is running, it will be stopped first.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Starts a stopped VirtualMachine by creating a VirtualMachineInstance. The VM must be in the Stopped state. Optionally accepts a start options body to control start behavior such as pausing immediately after start.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Stops a running VirtualMachine by deleting its VirtualMachineInstance. Optionally accepts stop options including a grace period for shutdown.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Restarts a running VirtualMachine by stopping and starting it. The VM must currently be running.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Initiates a live migration of the running VirtualMachine to another node. Creates a VirtualMachineInstanceMigration resource to track the migration.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Pauses the CPU execution of a running VirtualMachineInstance. The VMI remains in memory but no CPU cycles are consumed.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Resumes CPU execution of a paused VirtualMachineInstance.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: Label selector to filter resources.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: Field selector to filter resources.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results per page.

items.docs: Returns all running VirtualMachineInstance resources in the specified namespace. Each VMI represents an active virtual machine process.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Returns the specified VirtualMachineInstance including its phase, network interfaces, volumes, node assignment, and guest OS information.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Opens a WebSocket connection to the VNC console of the specified VirtualMachineInstance for graphical console access.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Opens a WebSocket connection to the serial console of the specified VirtualMachineInstance for text-based console access.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: Label selector to filter resources.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results per page.

items.docs: Returns all VirtualMachineInstanceMigration resources in the specified namespace. Each migration resource tracks the state of a live migration.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

items.docs: Initiates a live migration by creating a VirtualMachineInstanceMigration resource. The migration moves the VMI to another node while it continues running.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Returns the specified migration resource including its current phase, source and target node information, and completion status.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the resource.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the resource.

items.docs: Cancels an in-progress migration by deleting the VirtualMachineInstanceMigration resource.
